title: Soviet paleocontact theories

tellings.quote: Figures like Alexander Kazantsev and Felix Zigel proposed that alien visitors may have influenced early human development,

plain: Two Soviet thinkers, Alexander Kazantsev and Felix Zigel, proposed that alien visitors may have shaped early human development. This idea is called paleocontact: the belief that beings from elsewhere made contact with ancient humans. Michels mentions it himself, without naming a source, as part of the longer history of people asking whether visitors had a hand in human origins.
